game_concept: A action defense set in Eldritch Ruins – Broken Colonnade, a row of broken columns: the relic hunter must handle ghost knights while practicing lists. Core idea – Shelf Sorter: Use sort() to rearrange shelves of glyph tablets from smallest to largest.
theme: Eldritch Ruins – Broken Colonnade: a row of broken columns
core_gameplay_loop: In Broken Colonnade, repeat each round: Use sort() to rearrange shelves of glyph tablets from smallest to largest. Each round, ghost knights strike the glyph door, so respond before the next strike lands. Then check the order_score value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Bonus coins for fast correct moves
player_objective: Protect the glyph door from ghost knights in Broken Colonnade: keep the order_score meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 29-second timer ends.
controls: Keyboard: arrow keys move the hero, SPACE performs the main action, ENTER runs the code.
lose_condition: order_score drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 29-second timer ends.
learning_alignment: Week 7 – Lists | Level 3 (intro tier): Shelf Sorter
assets_style: mysterious pixel-art ruins: mossy stone pillars, overgrown arches, faint eldritch glow; flat Kenney-style sprites; eerie choir pads and stone-scrape stings
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Shelf Sorter' (Week 7 slot 6), mission type 'Survival Siege', and setting 'Broken Colonnade'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Eldritch Ruins

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how order_score changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against ghost knights in Broken Colonnade.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Timer reaches 29 seconds while order_score > 0.
